SYNTHETIC fixture (generated by tests/make_fixtures.py; no real exam content).

Two invented midsem papers (MS2024B, MS2025) with their corpus OCR text, page-picture PDFs, manifest rows
and receipts (rects + fresh region OCR). MS2024B-1a/1b/1c and MS2025-1c are Q1 table rows lost from the
corpus OCR (absent, or only a tail survives): they pass only via the receipt's fresh OCR. The tail words
also occur in other questions of the same paper, so those rows keep stray corpus positions that no other
question owns. It reproduces the bug fixed in commit 31c5b73: the old verify_pyqs.py let those stray
positions into the duplicate check and blocked the rows as 'duplicates another question (owns 0 ...)'.
Used by tests/test_verify.py.
